# The second E11 drill: the E9 bookings app (T9), with the task's exact names, tables and
# fields, built from `alder new bookings --bare` with commands only (first recorded by a fresh
# agent in the M13 final review). One command a line; a `fill` reads the lines after it up to
# EOF. cmd/alder/drill_test.go replays it, then checks the names, and runs the app's tests, the
# E9 hidden tests, and `alder test --mutate`.

# the users, and logging in
alder new table User email:Text.Email@unique name:Text.NonEmpty passwordHash:Text created:Time@created --no-timestamps
alder new auth --users User

# the rooms and their bookings: a booking holds [from, to)
alder new table Room name:Text.NonEmpty --no-timestamps
alder new table Booking room:Room.RoomId@ref=Room owner:User.UserId@ref=User from:Date to:Date --no-timestamps
alder new decl Booking holds "Date -> Booking -> Bool"
alder fill Booking.holds - <<'EOF'
\d b -> b.from <= d && d < b.to
EOF
alder new decl Booking overlaps "Date -> Date -> Booking -> Bool"
alder fill Booking.overlaps - <<'EOF'
\from to b -> from < b.to && b.from < to
EOF
alder new decl Booking nextFree "Date -> List Booking -> Date"
alder fill Booking.nextFree - <<'EOF'
\today bookings -> {
  let candidates = [today] ++ List.map (\b -> b.to) bookings
  let free = List.filter (\c -> c >= today && not (List.any (holds c) bookings)) candidates
  List.head (List.sortBy (\c -> Date.diffDays today c) free) ?? today
}
EOF
alder new test Booking "the next free date after back-to-back bookings"
alder fill 'Booking."the next free date after back-to-back bookings"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let free = nextFree today [
    { id: BookingId "a", room: Room.RoomId "r", owner: User.UserId "u", from: today, to: Date.addDays 2 today },
    { id: BookingId "b", room: Room.RoomId "r", owner: User.UserId "u", from: Date.addDays 2 today, to: Date.addDays 5 today },
    { id: BookingId "c", room: Room.RoomId "r", owner: User.UserId "u", from: Date.addDays 6 today, to: Date.addDays 8 today },
    { id: BookingId "d", room: Room.RoomId "r", owner: User.UserId "u", from: Date.addDays (-9) today, to: Date.addDays (-4) today },
  ]
  let later = nextFree today [
    { id: BookingId "e", room: Room.RoomId "r", owner: User.UserId "u", from: Date.addDays 3 today, to: Date.addDays 4 today },
  ]
  Task.succeed ({ free: free, later: later } == { free: Date.addDays 5 today, later: today })
}
EOF
alder new decl Room nameOf "List Room -> RoomId -> Text"
alder fill Room.nameOf - <<'EOF'
\rooms id -> match List.find (\r -> r.id == id) rooms {
  Just r -> r.name,
  Nothing -> "",
}
EOF

# the four pages, blank: their Model, load and view are filled below
alder new page Rooms.Index /rooms --blank --requires user
alder new page Rooms.Show /rooms --show Room --blank --requires user
alder new page Bookings.Index /bookings --blank --requires user
alder new page Bookings.Show /bookings --show Booking --blank --requires user

# where a login goes, now that the page is there (`alder new auth` left the hole ?afterLogin)
alder fill Auth.Login.update.Submit - <<'EOF'
Rooms.Index {}
EOF
alder fill 'Auth.Login."logging in through the form"' - <<'EOF'
Rooms.Index {}
EOF

# /rooms: every room by name, with its next free date
alder fill --decl Rooms.Index.Model - <<'EOF'
{ today: Date, rooms: List Room, bookings: List Booking }
EOF
alder fill Rooms.Index.load - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let rooms <- Db.from Room |> Db.orderBy Room.name.asc |> Db.all
  let bookings <- Db.from Booking |> Db.all
  Query.succeed { today: today, rooms: rooms, bookings: bookings }
}
EOF
alder fill Rooms.Index.view - <<'EOF'
<Layout.Page title="Rooms">
  <h1>Rooms</h1>
  <ul id="rooms">
    {for r in model.rooms ->
      <li>
        <a class="name" href={Rooms.Show { id: r.id }}>{r.name}</a>
        {" "}
        <span class="free">{Date.toText (Booking.nextFree model.today (List.filter (\b -> b.room == r.id) model.bookings))}</span>
      </li>}
  </ul>
  <a href={Bookings.Index {}}>My bookings</a>
  <al-button variant="outline" click={App.Logout}>Log out</al-button>
</Layout.Page>
EOF
alder new test Rooms.Index "rooms are listed by name with their next free date"
alder fill 'Rooms.Index."rooms are listed by name with their next free date"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let red <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Red" }
  let blue <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Blue" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Green" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: blue, owner: me, from: today, to: Date.addDays 2 today }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: blue, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 2 today, to: Date.addDays 4 today }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: red, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 1 today, to: Date.addDays 3 today }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let page <- Test.get (Rooms.Index {})
  Task.succeed ({ names: Test.texts "#rooms li .name" page.doc, free: Test.texts "#rooms li .free" page.doc } == { names: ["Blue", "Green", "Red"], free: [Date.toText (Date.addDays 4 today), Date.toText today, Date.toText today] })
}
EOF

# /rooms/{id}: the room, its bookings by from, and the form to book it
alder fill --decl Rooms.Show.Model - <<'EOF'
{ room: Room, bookings: List Booking }
EOF
alder fill Rooms.Show.load - <<'EOF'
{
  let found <- Db.get Room params.id
  let bookings <- Db.from Booking |> Db.where (Booking.room.eq params.id) |> Db.orderBy Booking.from.asc |> Db.all
  match found {
    Just room -> Query.succeed { room: room, bookings: bookings },
    Nothing -> Query.notFound,
  }
}
EOF
alder fill Rooms.Show.view - <<'EOF'
<Layout.Page title={model.room.name}>
  <h1 id="name">{model.room.name}</h1>
  <ul id="bookings">
    {for b in model.bookings ->
      <li>
        <span class="from">{Date.toText b.from}</span>
        {" to "}
        <span class="to">{Date.toText b.to}</span>
      </li>}
  </ul>
  <a href={Rooms.Index {}}>All rooms</a>
</Layout.Page>
EOF
alder new form Rooms.Show NewBooking from:Date to:Date --msg Book
alder fill Rooms.Show.update.Book - <<'EOF'
{
  let existing <- Db.from Booking |> Db.where (Booking.room.eq model.room.id) |> Db.all
  if p.form.to <= p.form.from then Task.succeed (Reject "The end date must be after the start date.")
  else if List.any (Booking.overlaps p.form.from p.form.to) existing then Task.succeed (Reject "The room is already booked for some of these dates.")
  else {
    let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: model.room.id, owner: session.user, from: p.form.from, to: p.form.to }
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Rooms.Show { id: model.room.id }))
  }
}
EOF
alder fill 'Rooms.Show."submitting NewBooking"' - <<'EOF'
FormRejected [{ field: "", message: "The end date must be after the start date." }]
EOF
alder new test Rooms.Show "an overlapping booking is refused, one starting where another ends is stored"
alder fill 'Rooms.Show."an overlapping booking is refused, one starting where another ends is stored"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let room <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Blue" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: room, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 1 today, to: Date.addDays 3 today }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Rooms.Show { id: room })
  let refused <- Test.submit NewBooking { from: Date.addDays 2 today, to: Date.addDays 4 today }
  let n1 <- Db.from Booking |> Db.count
  let stored <- Test.submit NewBooking { from: Date.addDays 3 today, to: Date.addDays 5 today }
  let n2 <- Db.from Booking |> Db.count
  Task.succeed ({ refused: refused.answer, n1: n1, stored: stored.answer, n2: n2 } == { refused: FormRejected [{ field: "", message: "The room is already booked for some of these dates." }], n1: 1, stored: Redirected (Rooms.Show { id: room }), n2: 2 })
}
EOF
alder new test Rooms.Show "a booking ending where another starts, or of another room, is stored"
alder fill 'Rooms.Show."a booking ending where another starts, or of another room, is stored"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let room <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Blue" }
  let other <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Red" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: room, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 3 today, to: Date.addDays 5 today }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: other, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 1 today, to: Date.addDays 9 today }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Rooms.Show { id: room })
  let r <- Test.submit NewBooking { from: Date.addDays 1 today, to: Date.addDays 3 today }
  let page <- Test.get (Rooms.Show { id: room })
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, from: Test.texts "#bookings .from" page.doc, to: Test.texts "#bookings .to" page.doc, name: Test.text "#name" page.doc } == { answer: Redirected (Rooms.Show { id: room }), from: [Date.toText (Date.addDays 1 today), Date.toText (Date.addDays 3 today)], to: [Date.toText (Date.addDays 3 today), Date.toText (Date.addDays 5 today)], name: Just "Blue" })
}
EOF

# /bookings: the user's own bookings by from, each linking to its page
alder fill --decl Bookings.Index.Model - <<'EOF'
{ bookings: List Booking, rooms: List Room }
EOF
alder fill Bookings.Index.load - <<'EOF'
{
  let bookings <- Db.from Booking |> Db.where (Booking.owner.eq session.user) |> Db.orderBy Booking.from.asc |> Db.all
  let rooms <- Db.from Room |> Db.all
  Query.succeed { bookings: bookings, rooms: rooms }
}
EOF
alder fill Bookings.Index.view - <<'EOF'
<Layout.Page title="My bookings">
  <h1>My bookings</h1>
  <ul id="mine">
    {for b in model.bookings ->
      <li>
        <a href={Bookings.Show { id: b.id }}><span class="room">{Room.nameOf model.rooms b.room}</span>{" from "}<span class="from">{Date.toText b.from}</span></a>
      </li>}
  </ul>
  <a href={Rooms.Index {}}>Rooms</a>
</Layout.Page>
EOF
alder new test Bookings.Index "my bookings are listed by from, with their rooms"
alder fill 'Bookings.Index."my bookings are listed by from, with their rooms"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let other <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "other@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Other", passwordHash: "" }
  let blue <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Blue" }
  let red <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Red" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: blue, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 5 today, to: Date.addDays 6 today }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: red, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 1 today, to: Date.addDays 2 today }
  let _ <- Db.insert Booking { room: red, owner: other, from: Date.addDays 3 today, to: Date.addDays 4 today }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let page <- Test.get (Bookings.Index {})
  Task.succeed ({ rooms: Test.texts "#mine li .room" page.doc, from: Test.texts "#mine li .from" page.doc, link: Test.has "#mine li a" page.doc } == { rooms: ["Red", "Blue"], from: [Date.toText (Date.addDays 1 today), Date.toText (Date.addDays 5 today)], link: True })
}
EOF

# /bookings/{id}: one booking, for its owner only; Cancel while today is before its from
alder fill --decl Bookings.Show.Model - <<'EOF'
{ booking: Booking, room: Room, today: Date }
EOF
alder fill Bookings.Show.load - <<'EOF'
{
  let found <- Db.get Booking params.id
  let today <- Date.today
  match found {
    Just booking -> if booking.owner == session.user then {
      let room <- Db.get Room booking.room
      match room {
        Just r -> Query.succeed { booking: booking, room: r, today: today },
        Nothing -> Query.notFound,
      }
    } else Query.notFound,
    Nothing -> Query.notFound,
  }
}
EOF
alder fill Bookings.Show.view - <<'EOF'
<Layout.Page title="Booking">
  <h1 id="room">{model.room.name}</h1>
  <p>From <span id="from">{Date.toText model.booking.from}</span> to <span id="to">{Date.toText model.booking.to}</span></p>
  <a href={Bookings.Index {}}>My bookings</a>
</Layout.Page>
EOF
alder new msg Bookings.Show Cancel --id cancel --when "model.today < model.booking.from"
alder fill Bookings.Show.update.Cancel - <<'EOF'
if model.today < model.booking.from then {
  let _ <- Db.delete Booking model.booking.id
  Task.succeed (Redirect (Bookings.Index {}))
} else Task.succeed (Reject "This booking can no longer be cancelled.")
EOF
alder fill --decl 'Bookings.Show."pressing Cancel"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let room <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Blue" }
  let booking <- Db.insert Booking { room: room, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 1 today, to: Date.addDays 3 today }
  let _ <- Test.get (Bookings.Show { id: booking })
  let r <- Test.click Cancel
  let after <- Db.get Booking booking
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, left: Maybe.isJust after } == { answer: Redirected (Bookings.Index {}), left: False })
}
EOF
alder new test Bookings.Show "a booking whose from is today cannot be cancelled"
alder fill 'Bookings.Show."a booking whose from is today cannot be cancelled"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let room <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Blue" }
  let id <- Db.insert Booking { room: room, owner: me, from: today, to: Date.addDays 2 today }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let page <- Test.get (Bookings.Show { id: id })
  let r <- Test.run (update Cancel page.model { user: me })
  let after <- Db.get Booking id
  Task.succeed ({ button: Test.has "#cancel" page.doc, value: r.value, left: Maybe.isJust after, room: Test.text "#room" page.doc, from: Test.text "#from" page.doc, to: Test.text "#to" page.doc } == { button: False, value: Ok (Reject "This booking can no longer be cancelled."), left: True, room: Just "Blue", from: Just (Date.toText today), to: Just (Date.toText (Date.addDays 2 today)) })
}
EOF
alder new test Bookings.Show "a booking of another user is not found"
alder fill 'Bookings.Show."a booking of another user is not found"' - <<'EOF'
{
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let other <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "other@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Other", passwordHash: "" }
  let room <- Db.insert Room { name: Text.NonEmpty "Blue" }
  let id <- Db.insert Booking { room: room, owner: me, from: Date.addDays 3 today, to: Date.addDays 4 today }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just other }
  let r <- Test.open (Bookings.Show { id: id })
  Task.succeed (r.answer == PageMissing)
}
EOF

# the app's own tests
alder check
alder test
